Method of Attack: Memory corruption leading to remote code execution
Improper validation of file paths allowing arbitrary code execution
Buffer overflow vulnerability in SQL Server
Improper handling of objects in memory in Windows PDF library

Opening a specially crafted file via email or web page

Viewing a website with malicious PDF content
Sending a specially crafted email to the vulnerable Exchange server
Serving maliciously embedded fonts via a website or document file
Using a malicious .LNK file and associated binary
